_comment: Adhan recordings the app may ship. Only freely licensed recordings with a clear chain of rights. status=bundled: processed files are in the repo (store-assets/adhan + android res/raw). status=candidate: run scripts/fetch-adhan.sh (needs network access to the source host), LISTEN to it, then set status to bundled. See docs/APP.md#adhan-recordings.

recordings.author: Provided by the owner of نور القرآن
recordings.license: Owner-provided (rights held by the app owner)
recordings.source: Uploaded by the app owner on 2026-11-23 (My_Audio17.mp3)
recordings.evidence: Chosen by the owner as the only Fajr adhan. Muezzin name and written permission to be confirmed by the owner before store release.
